what: Mondelez International makes snacks. Its brands include Oreo, Cadbury, Milka, Toblerone, Ritz and LU, sold in more than 150 countries, with chocolate and biscuits the core of the business.
customers: Consumers through supermarkets, convenience stores and e-commerce worldwide, with a large share of sales in emerging markets.
money: Cadbury, Milka, Toblerone and Côte d'Or
Oreo, Ritz, LU, belVita and Tate's
gum and candy, cheese and grocery, powdered beverages
moat: Brands with a century of recognition, shelf space in millions of shops, and distribution reach in emerging markets built over decades.
risks: Cocoa prices rose to record levels and squeezed chocolate margins hard

opportunities: Cocoa prices falling back would restore margins quickly
